exposure: Four groups: no obesity no GDM (reference), isolated GDM, isolated obesity, obesity with GDM
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 1,618 women who delivered at a Brazilian Maternity Hospital between August and December 2020
finding: Both obesity and GDM independently increased the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, with the risk further amplified when the two conditions were present together.
mod_finding: Isolated GDM increased the chance of cesarean section, while obesity with GDM increased the chance of cesarean section and LGA newborns.
